rag.text:
Test: TC-4869 — Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning - Verifying link types in Jira after cloning
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-70 Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning
Labels: teamembers, teamscheduling

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxname
   Data: boxname: TC-4710 Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning - Verifying link types in Jira after cloning
   Expected: Gantt module opens with following task:

* issue#1
2. Click + button from header
   Expected: Dropdown appear with following options:

* Create task
* (disabled) Create subtask
* Manage scope definition
* Import tasks from file
* Clone existing scope
3. Click Clone existing scope
   Expected: Clone existing scope window shows up with 

* Clone the Scope from select
* Clone the scope to select
* Read more button
* Cancel button
* Clone button
4. Click on the select underneath Clone the scope from, type boxName and click on it in dropdown
   Data: boxname: TC-4710 Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning - Verifying link types in Jira after cloning
   Expected: "TC-4710 Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning - Verifying link types in Jira after cloning" is filled in 'Clone the scope from' select
5. Click on the select underneath Clone the scope to, type projectName and click on it in dropdown
   Data: projectName: TC-4710 Clone To
   Expected: "TC-4710 Clone To" is filled in 'Clone the scope to' select
6. Click Clone button and then Proceed button
   Expected: After a while, window Tasks have been successfully cloned shows up. Both projects TC-4710 Clone To and TC-4710  Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning - Verifying link types in Jira after cloning will be visible in the scope of TC-4710  Feature area - Box scope - Existing tasks cloning (…)
7. Navigate to projectName in Jira
   Data: projectName: TC-4710 Clone To
   Expected: Backlog of "TC-4710 Clone To" is opened. 
issue#1 is visible in the backlog.
8. Open issueName in Jira
   Data: issueName: issue#1
   Expected: issue#1 is opened. 

Issue links has a "*clones*" link.
